question: According to Census 2011, what is the total literacy rate in India (approximately)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**74%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** literacy rate** in India has been **steadily increasing** over the years.
 
• In **Census 2001**, it was **64.8%**, which increased to **74.04%** in **Census 2011.**
 
• The **male literacy rate** is** higher** than the female literacy rate in India.
 
• In** Census 2011**, the male literacy rate was **82.14%,** while the female literacy rate was** 65.46%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala **has the** highest literacy rate** among all the states in India, with a rate of** 94%.**
 
• The literacy rate is an important indicator of the** development of a country.**
 
• It is defined as the percentage of people who can **read and write **with understanding a simple statement related to their daily life.
